0022600162.text: The Wizards (3-3, road record 1-2, 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East) visit the Orlando Magic (2-4, home record 0-3, 5th in the Southeast and 1 game back, 10th in the East) in the Wizards' seventh game of the season, with Orlando coming off a loss. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve), while Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. Orlando will be without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and the Wizards lost their most recent meeting 136-131 in Orlando, the last of their 1-3 series loss in 2025-26.
